data.title: Alaunos Therapeutics Faces Nasdaq Delisting, Seeks Hearing
data.description:
Alaunos Therapeutics ( (TCRT) ) has issued an announcement.

On April 9, 2026, Alaunos Therapeutics received notice from Nasdaq that it was not in compliance with Listing Rule 5550(b)(1), which requires at least $2.5 million in stockholders’ equity for continued listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market. After submitting a plan to regain compliance, the company was informed on October 5, 2026 that its securities are subject to delisting unless it requests a hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel.

Alaunos plans to request this hearing, a step that will temporarily halt any suspension or delisting action while the Panel reviews its case and any extension periods. The company is also working with a financial advisor to evaluate strategic alternatives and potential transactions aimed at strengthening its financial position and restoring compliance, though it cautioned there is no assurance that these efforts or any resulting deal will succeed in preserving its Nasdaq listing.
